profile.name: Karthick Raja G
profile.heroSummary: 2026 IT graduate building full-stack applications and cloud infrastructure. I work with React and Node.js, automate AWS with Terraform and Ansible, and ship applications through Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and GitOps on Kubernetes.
bio: I'm a 2026 Information Technology graduate from Adhiparasakthi College of Engineering, Ranipet (2022-2026), with a CGPA of 7.8. I completed a DevOps internship at JSpiders from January to September 2026.

I provision infrastructure with Terraform and Ansible, deploy multi-tier AWS applications with load balancing and auto scaling, and migrate workloads to managed services including Elastic Beanstalk, RDS, ElastiCache, and Amazon MQ.

I build Jenkins and GitHub Actions pipelines, deliver to EKS through Helm and Argo CD, and use Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki for monitoring. I also built Optic, a Kubernetes desktop workspace, and verified its logs, terminals, port forwarding, and 39 resource lists against a live cluster.

Open-source recognition: Optic's Helm 4 compatibility and collapsible navigation work (15 files, 509 lines, tests included) was selected for the XERJ Corpus Hub public index as a reference for AI coding agents, with author and repository attribution under the project's MIT licence.
I build full-stack systems with React and Node, automate infrastructure with Python, Bash, Terraform, boto3, and Fabric, and use AI-assisted tools to ship with more focus.

projects.title: vprofile GitOps - Terraform, Helm & Argo CD on EKS
projects.description: Split vprofile across infrastructure, Helm chart, and application repositories, each with its own pipeline. Terraform validates, plans, and provisions EKS, checks drift, and posts results to Slack, with a separate destroy job. Application pushes run Maven tests, Checkstyle, and a SonarQube quality gate before pushing Docker images to ECR. An image-tag pull request updates the Helm repo; merging it triggers Argo CD to deploy the new version on EKS.

projects.title: Optic - Kubernetes Desktop Workspace
projects.description: Built a desktop Kubernetes workspace with live resource tables, pod logs, tabbed terminals, YAML editing, scaling, rollouts, and Helm installs. CPU and memory charts use Prometheus with a metrics-server fallback. Tests run against a fake Kubernetes API; GitHub Actions runs unit tests, Electron smoke tests, and packaging. Verified logs, pod shells, port forwarding, and all 39 resource lists on a live cluster, including diagnosing an Argo CD ImagePullBackOff caused by an unavailable Redis image tag.

projects.title: vprofile on Kubernetes - Multi-tier App Deployment
projects.description: Deployed Tomcat, RabbitMQ, Memcache, and MySQL in separate Kubernetes pods behind their own Services. An AWS Application Load Balancer and Ingress route external traffic only to Tomcat. MySQL uses a PersistentVolumeClaim, StorageClass, and Amazon EBS volume to preserve data through pod restarts. Database and RabbitMQ credentials are stored in Kubernetes Secrets.

projects.title: Monitoring & Logging Stack - Prometheus, Grafana, Loki on AWS
projects.description: Built a monitoring and logging stack across four EC2 instances. Prometheus collects host metrics from a Python Flask app server, Promtail ships its logs to Loki, and Grafana reads both for dashboards. Security Groups expose only ports 80/443 publicly, restrict Grafana and Prometheus to admin IPs or VPN access, and allow Loki traffic only from the app server and Grafana.

projects.title: VProfile - Dual CI/CD Pipeline
projects.description: Built Jenkins and GitHub Actions pipelines for the same application to compare the workflows side by side. Both pipelines run Maven build and test, SonarQube quality analysis, Trivy vulnerability scanning, Docker image builds, ECR publishing, and ECS deployment with secure secret retrieval.

projects.title: vprofile-project - AWS Microservices Deployment
projects.description: Deployed a multi-tier AWS application on EC2 behind an Elastic Load Balancer with Auto Scaling, separate Security Groups for Tomcat, RabbitMQ, Memcache, and MySQL, and Route 53 DNS. Later migrated Tomcat to Elastic Beanstalk, MySQL to RDS, Memcached to ElastiCache, and RabbitMQ to Amazon MQ. S3 stores artifacts, Route 53 and CloudFront handle delivery, and CloudWatch monitors the load balancer and instances.

projects.title: Productivity Monitoring System

projects.title: OTT Video Streaming Platform
projects.description: Built an OTT platform on React.js, Node.js, Java, MySQL, and AWS S3 that scaled to 50,000+ monthly active users. Held 99.9% uptime and cut video load times by 30% by reworking the RESTful APIs and JWT auth flow.

projects.title: Learning Management System (LMS)
projects.description: Built a full-stack LMS covering course creation, enrollment, progress tracking, and an admin dashboard behind JWT authentication. Designed the RESTful APIs and MySQL schema from scratch.

projects.title: Serverless Web Application - Internshala
projects.description: Built a serverless app on AWS using S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, and Lambda with Python and Node.js, using DynamoDB for storage and secure CRUD operations through API Gateway.
